subsystems.name: scheduler-cpp-control-plane
subsystems.description: C++ finite-state machine control plane for request lifecycle, scheduling, and cache coordination. Compile-time state safety via std::variant.

subsystems.name: scheduler-python-execution-plane
subsystems.description: Python bindings for the C++ scheduler. Thin wrapper; heavy lifting in C++.

subsystems.name: kernel-registry-selection
subsystems.description: Pluggable kernel system with FormatSignature, capability gating, per-family oracles, and selection objectives (latency/throughput/portability/determinism/debug).

subsystems.name: kernel-operations
subsystems.description: Individual kernel implementations registered via @register_kernel decorator. Includes MHA, MLA, DSA, DSV4, MoE, sampling, quantization, etc.

subsystems.name: mla-kernels
subsystems.description: MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) prefill and decode kernels for Blackwell. CuTe DSL JIT + optional AOT binary backend. fold_sq_factor for small-head decode.

subsystems.name: entrypoint-async-llm
subsystems.description: Engine entrypoint with tokenizer manager, scheduler subprocess, detokenizer. Headless mode for SMG integration via msgpack ZMQ.

subsystems.name: event-loop-scheduler-worker
subsystems.description: Main scheduler worker loop. Builds device side, runs event_loop with in_flight_depth overlap, commits forward results, advances scheduler.

subsystems.name: execution-device-side
subsystems.description: Device-side execution: model runners, CUDA graphs, forward threads, prefill graphs, cache location kernels.

subsystems.name: models
subsystems.description: Model implementations with local-SPMD compiler generating collective communication from module-boundary annotations.

subsystems.name: attention-backends
subsystems.description: Attention backend implementations integrating kernel selection with KV cache recipes.

subsystems.name: kv-cache-recipes
subsystems.description: Per-model KV cache layout specifications and admission plans.

subsystems.name: epd-disaggregation
subsystems.description: Encode-Prefill-Disaggregation: encode workers compute vision embeddings, ship via Mooncake to prefill node.

completeness_critic: Exhaustive fan-out across scheduler (C++ FSM + Python), kernel registry/selection, MLA, entrypoint, event loop, models/layers. Skipped third-party vendored code (CUTLASS, FlashInfer, DeepEP). All load-bearing subsystems opened.
